library: Combat Reviews benchmark study library (synthetic acceptance fixtures)

references.title: Synthetic fast-cut vertical reference
prohibitedUses: no use in any produced advertisement or other output
references.operatorNotes: Synthetic six-scene one-second-per-cut fixture. Exists to exercise pacing measurement, not to demonstrate craft.

annotation.hookMechanism: Immediate colour change on the first frame with no build-up.
annotation.narrativeStructure: Six equal beats with no escalation.
annotation.transferablePrinciple: A uniform one-second cut rhythm sustains attention in a vertical feed but flattens emphasis: nothing stands out because every beat is the same length.
annotation.prohibitedDirectSimilarity: Do not reproduce any specific colour sequence or cut pattern from a third-party advertisement; take the pacing principle only.

references.title: Synthetic slow-cut vertical reference
prohibitedUses: no use in any produced advertisement or other output
references.operatorNotes: Synthetic three-scene fixture with a longer hold, for contrast against the fast-cut reference.

annotation.hookMechanism: A long opening hold that asks the viewer to wait.
annotation.narrativeStructure: Three beats, decreasing in length toward the close.
annotation.transferablePrinciple: Holding an opening shot for three seconds buys comprehension at the cost of scroll-stopping power; it suits a considered proposition, not a volume claim.
annotation.prohibitedDirectSimilarity: Do not copy any third-party opening composition; the principle is the hold duration, not the image.

references.title: Synthetic landscape two-shot reference
prohibitedUses: no use in any produced advertisement or other output
references.operatorNotes: Landscape fixture, to prove aspect ratio is measured rather than assumed vertical.

annotation.transferablePrinciple: A landscape reference cannot be judged on vertical safe areas; aspect ratio must be measured before any framing lesson is drawn from it.
annotation.prohibitedDirectSimilarity: Do not crop or reframe third-party landscape footage for vertical output under any circumstances.

references.title: Professional reference registered by link only
references.campaign: Registered for research without acquiring media
permittedUses: manual research via the official public URL
prohibitedUses: no use in any produced advertisement or other output
references.jurisdictionNotes: Public availability is not permission. No media bytes are acquired for this record; it exists so a researcher can find the official page again.
references.operatorNotes: Link-only: no technical or craft measurement will ever be produced for this record, because no media was acquired.

annotation.transferablePrinciple: A reference can be catalogued and reasoned about from its public page alone; acquiring a copy is a separate decision requiring a separate legal basis.
annotation.prohibitedDirectSimilarity: Do not reconstruct this advertisement's execution from memory or description.
